lines.en: I find myself on the way to Yasu’s church (That I very frequently forget the name of) after Touka informs me over the phone that there is going to be a “presentation” of sorts today.

As it turns out, the fliers Yasu handed out all over town (Or attempted to hand out all over town) did in fact generate some sort of buzz- albeit from other members of the class rather than normal citizens.
And no, I am not counting the girls of class 1-A as “normal citizens” because, let’s face it, a handful of them are arguably more abnormal than even I am.
So as I listen to my footsteps bouncing off of brick buildings down this lengthy concrete hall, I wonder if there is anyone somewhat “normal” caught in the confines of this place.
I think back to the faceless passersby and where their faces must have gone before realizing that maybe “normal” is just the polite way of saying “boring.”
Maybe those people have some interesting traits mixed in with what’s missing. And maybe what’s missing is a mixture of malice and madness or whatever it is that makes me more visible than them.
Whatever it is, I thank my footsteps (As they’re my only current company) for the fact that I am not one of those faceless silhouettes.
But I scorn the necessity of sorrow and open my arms to the possibility of their supposed numbness taking its place. Though, maybe I just haven’t made it to that step yet.
Anyway, church. Yasu. Yasu’s church.
The place I’m going.
The presentation being presented and the presence of the presents she will offer in exchange for my time and my effort — both things better spent on girls with darker hair.
I wonder who will care enough to show up — or is kind enough to show up — or is bored enough to show up.
Then I wonder how many words it will take for them to realize that all of this is nonsense.
There is no god inside of that building.
They’re all trapped inside of my head.
: Thank you very much for taking the time out of your days and your lives to experience a taste of mine, however sour it may be.
: I am Yasu Yasui and I am a divine messenger of the one true God.
: It is my duty to deliver His word unto the people, and to help guide them toward a light they would never be able to find on their own.
: I’m glad you’re all here...for today is a special day. Or at least I would like to call it one...
: But it is not my place to call anywhere anything for any words that I have to say apart from what are His are vile and filthy and meant to be discarded.
: These doors were meant to stay locked for those who were not chosen...But in my choosing, they have been opened. And in turn, your unclean bodies have poisoned the air of His great cathedral...
: But this is...
: This is what has to be done...

: It is winter’s great departure and the fading of His voice combined with the presence of another that have spurred me into irrational action! Action that I’d never take without His blessing, of course!
: And shall I be cut down and turned to ribbons for this misdeed, it will have been worth it if such a terrible thing has managed to convey His glory to those I wish would join me in the-
: Ahem...
: A...Anyway...Thank you all for coming...Today I...I plan to share with you some details of...He Who Swallows All...And I will explain to you what steps you may take to begin...earning His favor.
: But...I can not guarantee that your efforts will bear fruit...for He has yet to smile upon all but two of you...
: And once more...this is naught more than a selfish act conceived by a selfish girl.
: One who shies away from the dark...yet feels it inching closer and closer to her tainted flesh with each passing storm.
: Well, this is definitely a weird crowd. But also mostly in line with my expectations.
: I have always prided myself as an innocent ball of spirituality and goodness. I’m sure it’s no surprise to see me spending what little free time I have getting closer to the lord.
: If you do anything to get closer to the lord, it’s probably just to have sex with him.
: Or her.
: Or them.
: Or anything, really. I can’t help but spread my legs at the first scent of divinity.
: If you two are here to make a mockery of Yasu’s religion, please just leave. She is sacrificing a great deal to make such a gathering possible and the least you could do is show her some respect.
: Respect is my second specialty, just after virtue. I am simply here to learn. Though I do have a third specialty that I’m hesitant to reveal in church.
: Are you really...in trouble with your god for letting us inside?...
: While no words have found me to suggest such a thing, there is a pit He has planted in my stomach that is now beginning to sprout.
: And each of its branches as they grow through and around my insides serves as a painful reminder that I must remain where I belong in the machine.
: That I am nothing more than a cog...and that adding unwanted parts to that machine will sooner damage it than cause it to better perform its function.
: Are you actually interested in this, Sana? It’s not your first time talking about this with Yasu, right?
: Right...
: I’m a little more...familiar with Yasu’s beliefs than most people, but...there’s still a lot I don’t know...And I guess I am a little interested...But I mostly just want to support her...
: I see that you, too, are a lady of the cloth?
: I mean...I don’t know if I’d go that far...
: ENOUGH! YOU EXIST IN HIS SHADOW AND BATHE IN HIS GLORY, YET JEST WHEN THE FRUITS OF TORMENT COULD BE PLUCKED FROM YOUR TREES AT ANY GIVEN-
: Please keep your voices low so as to not disturb the rest of the clergy. Thank you.
: I understand that the light of the moon may be influencing your words and thoughts, but it is very important to rid yourselves of such contaminants within the walls of my Lord’s only home.
: Now go ahead and tell them why your lord’s home is so important to you, Yasu.
: It’s important because I only exist when I’m inside of this church. Just as you only exist when wallowing in sin because that is all you know how to do.
: BUT I WILL TEACH YOU WHAT IT MEANS TO BE PURE!
: I WILL TEACH YOU HOW IT FEELS TO BASK IN THE ALL-CONSUMING SUN! HOW THE SCORCHING OF GUILT CAN SET ONE’S MIND ABLAZE.
: Please pay attention.
: Zachariel (the first) said to those who doubted his presence on the planet, “We are all but fodder once the sky turns red.”
: The others looked at him and laughed.
: They doubted a day would come when the white-soaked skies would douse the gas giant that only they could walk upon the deepest of crimsons.
: They danced and they danced, hands caked in flour while the archangel swam deep through the gas to never be seen again.
: SUCH FOOLS THEY WERE, THE LOT OF THEM! SUCH INSOLENCE AND COMPLACENCY IN THE FACE OF CERTAIN DOOM!
: Zachariel emerged on the other side and gazed back at his origin point- which had gone up in flames so extravagant that he could see it from aeons away. But he did not smile, no. He cried.
: His tears would pool up in his hands, clasped left over right so the dominant one would act as the ladle when the time came to drink their guilt.
: That time came once the fire went out. And while their sin was erased, they paid the ultimate price. But it all could have been avoided had they only listened.
: The light of the sun is meant to be absorbed, while the light of the moon is meant to be abhorred.
: Douse yourself in the blackest of blacks and take the light into your own body...lest there will be some who will attempt to take it for themselves.
: This is recycling in its purest form. You are to become the world — and in becoming the world, you are becoming one with Him.
: You may trade this light in for wonderful things. Beautiful things. And there is not a single one you’ll be forced to leave behind you when your time has come to move to the hidden plane.
: May I ask a question?
: Of course! I carry with me His unrivaled knowledge and will do anything I can to share it with you.
: Then, what exactly is this “hidden plane” you're referring to?
: Are you actually curious, Nodoka?
: I’m always curious. That’s who I am. There’s no point to life at all if you stop asking questions.
: Another layer...where those who depart this one roam once their time has come to an end.
: Some believe in Heaven or Hell...others believe in reincarnation...and many believe in pure darkness. But all of these things are wrong.
: There is no “afterlife” for life itself never ends, meaning there is nothing to come after it.
: His teachings tell us that we become observers once we’ve completed our mission here. And that those we leave behind take up the mantle from that point on.
: This will go on and on and on until there is no one left.
: What happens when there’s no one left?...
: He hasn’t told me yet. But if I had to guess...
: I imagine we’d all move somewhere else.
: Another plane.
: Nodoka?
: Is that how it works?...
: Is that the missing piece?...
: Are you...actually being swayed by Yasu’s speech?

: Her what? Oh, no. No, this is something else. This is a different thing. A thing you wouldn’t get. A thing none of you will ever get. But I have to get it because she got it. And if she got it, it means I can get it. Get it?

: That can’t be it. No. Something else. It’s something else. I can’t wait that long. And there was no mention of how many others there would be. There has to be another way. Something else. But what? How? Who?
Nodoka rants to herself for a moment, bringing her voice to such a broken whisper that I can’t make any of her words out even though I’m sitting right next to her.
Sana begins to bite her nails. She’s feeling nervous. I can tell.
She’s been kicking my leg periodically throughout the presentation, but I think she just wants to fuck me in one of the pews.
Maybe she’s turned on by the idea of God watching her narrow crevice violated by His favorite son.
Touka’s normal. Unswayed and unmoved after developing some sort of immunity to Yasu’s evangelical tendencies.
But now that she’s entered the monologue, I’m thinking of fucking her in one of the pews.
Can I convert for just the evening? Reap the benefits of unprotected sex in the name of the lord before lopping off my wings and becoming a heretic?
Would their flesh taste as sweet to a fallen angel? Or would my tongue die along with my wings since THAT has been the tool I’ve used to fly more frequently.
Meanwhile, Yasu-
Yasu.
She is floating.
That’s where my wings have gone. They’ve been given to her.
She’s got my tongue too. She holds it in her hand and drives a stake into the lower right quadrant of it. The sensation latches onto my gums as they’re all I have left now.
“68 65 20 69 73 20 69 6e 20 74 68 65 20 72 6f 6f 6d 20 77 69 74 68 20 75 73” she speaks, not knowing that his departure is imminent — for the door swings open and in walks-
Kaori?
: Oh! Another visitor! Such a pleasant surprise! Please do not touch the pews for you will only contaminate them. I will fetch you an extra chair from the-
: What is this place?
: This is New Hope Cathedral — home of The Creator. And I am but a humble messenger here to spread His word.
: Kaori, what are you doing here?
: Friendburger?!
: You know her, Sensei?
: I...do too...
: And the mini Sara is here as well?! What is giving?!
: Did you...get a flier too, Kaori?...
: Flier?
: Uhh...word-paper?

: No word-paper was received. I am inside of this place because I thought I would find a fluffy friend here. But I have found a Friend and he is not fluffy. Why will you not grow fur for me to pet, Burgerman?
: Can you spare a minute of your time to learn about our lord and savior?
: Savior? Is there danger to be feared?
: Are you not here to seek salvation?
: I am here to seek fluff.
: That is why you think you are here...but the truth is that this is no coincidence at all.
: You have wandered into a home for the holy because you want to be closer to Him.
: Which Him? Friendburger? Because he has already been inside of my human mouth and I do not know how much closer we can become.
: Sensei...really?
: Okay, that one wasn’t my fault.
: Ugh...at least this one is an adult.
: Him as in God.
: Friendburger is God?
: God is God. And if you were able to open the door, it means He wants to meet you. He wants to-
: If your sentence is complete, you are supposed to say “period” perio-
: Wha-
: Y-Yasu! Have you gone mad?! You can’t just grope strangers like that!
: Help! I am having the sex!
: There’s something here. It’s-
: The female body?
: It’s...familiar...
: And so...
: Non-consensual?!
: Angry...
: Maybe that has...something to do with the fact that you’re...you know...
: There is nothing I can do for you.
: Not yet.
: Y...Yasu! Apologize to the nice woman for violating her personal space! That was extremely inappropriate!
: Friendburger, what have you taught these small humans and why must they practice on my body?!
: Again, this one isn’t on me. But I don’t blame you all for immediately suspecting me for things like this based on my prior actions and can promise I’m only a little bit offended.
: My glove...it’s filthy...it must be washed...immediately...
: Okay, well I have work tonight, so...
: Yes, I believe now is as good a time as any to- Nodoka! Snap out of it!
: Don’t interrupt! I’m thinking!
: Okay...on behalf of Yasu and “He Who...Does Stuff,” I am ending this meeting.
: Thank you all for coming and, to the woman in black, please accept my sincerest apologies on behalf of my friend. She doesn’t know any better and-
: Wait, where did she go?
Move the cogs. Move the planet.
Move yourself.
Yasu’s affection has increased to [yasu_love]!
